id: \bCharizard!
en: \bCharizard!

id: \rLiza: You think you're good enough to enter this place? Just try it.
en: \rLiza: You think you're good enough to enter this place? Just try it.
it: \rLiza: Pensi di essere abbastanza bravo da entrare qui? Provaci pure.

id: \rLiza: You have a strong Charizard. How would you like me to train one of your Pokémon?
en: \rLiza: You have a strong Charizard. How would you like me to train one of your Pokémon?
it: \rLiza: Hai un Charizard forte. Che ne dici se allenassi uno dei tuoi Pokémon?

id: \rLiza: Go away. No one is allowed in this sacred land.
en: \rLiza: Go away. No one is allowed in this sacred land.
it: \rLiza: Vattene. Nessuno può entrare in questa terra sacra.

id: \rOh? But you only have one with you.
en: \rOh?  But you only have one with you.
it: \rOh? Ma ne hai solo uno con te.

id: \rWhich Pokémon would you like me to raise?
en: \rWhich Pokémon would you like me to raise?

id: \rFine.

id: \rIf you leave me that Pokémon, what are you gonna battle with?

id: \rCome back with some common sense.
en: \rCome back with some common sense.
it: \rTorna quando avrai un po' di buon senso.

id: \rI'll raise your \v[3] for a while.
en: \rI'll raise your \v[3] for a while.

en: \rI can raise two of your Pokémon. Would you like me to raise another?

id: \rOh? But you only have one Pokémon with you.
en: \rOh? But you only have one Pokémon with you.
it: \rOh? Ma hai un solo Pokémon con te.

id: \rYou can't go off without a Pokémon. Come back another time.
en: \rYou can't go off without a Pokémon. Come back another time.
it: \rNon puoi andartene senza un Pokémon. Torna un'altra volta.

en: \rVery good. Come again.

en: \rFine, I'll raise your \v[3] for a while.

id: \rCome back for it later.
en: \rCome back for it later.

id: \rOh, fine, then.\nCome again.
en: \rOh, fine, then.\nCome again.

en: \rHey \PN. How's it going? Your Pokémon got stronger.

id: \rBy level, your \v[3] has grown by about \v[4].
en: \rBy level, your \v[3] has grown by about \v[4].

en: \rDo you want your Pokémon back?

id: \rYour Pokémon team is full. Make room, then come see me.
en: \rYour Pokémon team is full. Make room, then come see me.
